title: userspaceresource
description: Retrieve a set of fields related to User's workspace.

totalSpace.description: Total attachment size allowed to have in User's workspace.A positive Number

referenceLimit.description: Total Amount of references allowed to have in User's workspace.A positive Number

referenceCount.description: Current Amount of references in the User's space.A positive Number

sizeAvailable.description: Current space size available in the User's space.A positive Number

unlimitedSpace.description: As true, the user has unlimited space for attachments.

referenceCountRemaining.description: Current Amount of references allowed to create in User's workspace.A positive Number

attachmentSize.description: Current size of all attachments in the User's workspace.A positive Number

system.description: As true, POST method is not allowed

readOnly.description: As true, PUT method is not allowed

idValue.description: Unique Identifier of a pointed resource

hidden.description: As true, GET method is not allowed

mandatory.description: As true, DELETE method is not allowed

display.description: Name of the resource to show users
